description: The 8-shell test, run. The additive shell-independent term kappa*(n_pp - n_nn) is not present in single-magic mirror-split data at A = 3, 15, 39, under any of three radius models. Scope-(a) negative: the form as reconstructed, not kappa as an ingredient.

radius_models.name: implied by the measured 3He charge radius

parameters.alpha_em_provenance: derived from q_0 in coulomb_energy, not CODATA

data.verdict: scope-(a) negative. The additive shell-independent form does not appear in the data at any tested shell under any tested radius. The residual is not constant in A, which no radius choice can repair, so the failure is not a normalisation artefact. This does NOT structurally exclude kappa; it establishes that the decomposition kappa was fitted in is not the strong+Coulomb mirror-split decomposition.

assertions.name: residual_is_not_shell_independent_under_any_radius_model
assertions.detail: the prediction is ONE number at every shell; the residual varies by derived: 0.543 MeV, empirical heavy-nucleus saturation constant: 0.526 MeV, implied by the measured 3He charge radius: 1.723 MeV across A = 3, 15, 39 -- so no constant fits, whatever the radius

assertions.name: A3_anchor_leaves_no_room_for_the_predicted_term
assertions.detail: at the anchor kappa was fitted at, the post-Coulomb residual is at most ~0.235 MeV under any radius model, against a predicted 2.141 MeV -- short by at least 9x

assertions.name: residual_changes_sign_under_the_derived_radius
assertions.detail: under the framework's own derived radius the residual is negative at A=3 and positive at A=15 -- not a constant of either sign

assertions.name: negative_is_scope_a_not_scope_b
assertions.detail: no proved invariant forbids kappa as an ingredient; this excludes the additive shell-independent form against a Coulomb baseline, nothing more
